history.content: ugh i just need to put this somewhere. my roommate left their dishes in the sink AGAIN. like a full sink. for the third day
A full sink for the third day would get under my skin too. That repetition feels like it really hit a nerve.
yeah and i already asked nicely last week. like i left a note even. and they just. ignored it? idk it feels small but it builds up when youre the only one who cares about the place
That sounds less like one small thing and more like being worn down by it not being taken seriously. Is it closer to irritation, resentment, or feeling dismissed?
resentment yeah. thats the word. like im not even mad about the dishes its that they dont care and i always end up doing it
Yes, resentment fits. It sounds like the dishes matter less than the feeling of being the one who ends up carrying it.
yeah. ok that actually helps to just say it out loud. thanks. gonna go deal with the sink lol
I’m glad it got a little clearer. Hope the sink is brief.
